faq.question: What is the recommended way to contact Ikhwan Ramadhan for a Frontend Developer position?
faq.answer: You may contact me directly via email at ikhwn.rdn@gmail.com, via WhatsApp at +62 823-8647-3410, or through the correspondence form on this page. I respond promptly to interview invitations and technical assessments.

faq.question: Are you available for on-site (WFO) work and relocation?
faq.answer: Yes. Having completed my degree in Informatics Engineering, I am fully available for on-site appointments, relocation across Indonesia, as well as hybrid and remote team structures.

faq.question: What core frontend competencies and T-shaped capabilities do you bring to an engineering team?
faq.answer: My primary focus is frontend web engineering within the React and Next.js ecosystem (App Router, SSR, SSG, ISR), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, client-side state management (Zustand, Angular Signals), server-state caching and API integration (TanStack Query, Axios), schema validation (Zod), and authentication (NextAuth, RBAC). Complementing this depth, my T-shaped foundation in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Prisma ORM enables me to collaborate effectively across backend API boundaries.
